# Formula Editing

Inline: $x^2+y^2=z^2$.

## Cases

$$
f(x)=\begin{cases}
x^2 & x < 0 \\
0 & x = 0 \\
\frac{1}{x} & x > 0
\end{cases}
$$

$$

4 & 5 & 6 \\
7 & 8 & 9

$$
